ADDED i2: Tolerance used by the EvoSuite-generated assertions on the returned root.

ADDED i4: Solving the sine function over a bracket that never converges within the allowed evaluation budget exhausts the maximal evaluation count and throws.
ADDED i6: Solving the cube-root function over a bracket from a negative lower endpoint up to a positive upper endpoint converges to a root very close to zero.

ADDED i8: Solving the cube-root function over a bracket whose upper endpoint is a tiny positive value returns that upper endpoint as the located root.
ADDED i9: Solving the ulp function with the single start-value overload, using a solver configured with explicit relative and function-value accuracies, returns the start
